coach.text:
Position summary for Triathlon / Time trial.

Here is what to work on, in order of importance:

1. Reach looks short. Shoulder angle 68° (target 80–100°). You may feel cramped. A 10 mm longer stem (or extending aerobar pads forward) is a common fix.

2. Position is more upright than typical for this style. Torso at 35° (typical 10–28°). Fine if comfort is the goal — otherwise lower the bars 5–10 mm at a time.

3. Soften your elbows. Elbows are nearly locked (128°). Keep a slight bend to absorb bumps; if you can't, reach is probably too long.

Golden rule: change one thing at a time, in small steps, ride for a few days, then re-test. Comfort and pain-free riding always beat textbook numbers.
